sources: recreation.gov search for 'Ruby Creek' (recreation area 16571 only, not reservable), 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/ruby-mountain-srma ('The campground has 22 camping sites, with a separate boat launch and parking area nearby. There is a seasonal volunteer campground host on site.'), read 2026-10-22

note: BLM (Dillon Field Office) Ruby Creek Recreation Area on the Upper Madison River, ~7 mi south of Cameron (about 20 mi south of Ennis): west off US-287 on Johnny Gulch Rd for 3 mi, campground on the left before the T; the boat launch and day-use parking are left after the T. Grassy sites, seasonal volunteer host, pack-in/pack-out. --Claude
summary: BLM's page (now a bare Ruby Creek Campground page) confirms 22 sites, a separate boat launch and a seasonal host; the 2025 BLM fee table ($12 -> $20) stands as recorded. Not stated any more: RV length (50 ft derived left), water, toilets, FCFS, season. Note trimmed of restated values and the fee history.
